department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants who want financial assistance consideration should apply by January 15.

gre_subject.value: ECE has no subject test on its page; the general GRE rule is in the GRE General field.

gre_general.value: PhD applicants must submit official GRE scores, except UH ECE or EE graduates who meet the department's conditions.
gre_general.quote: PhD Applicants: Submit official GRE scores directly to the Graduate Division Student Services | For PhD applicants who received a BS or an MS degree in ECE or EE from UH within the five years of their PhD application, the GRE requirement is waived

supervisor.value: The page says each doctoral student is assigned an advisor on entry, not before admission.

funding.value: The page only points applicants to an assistantship step; no funding rule is stated.

entry_route.value: PhD students need a master's in ECE or an equivalent, or must complete the MS course requirements.
entry_route.quote: Doctoral students must have a Master of Science (MS) degree in ECE or its equivalent; otherwise, the MS program course requirements must be met

notes: The Graduate Division's international deadline for fall is January 15, matching the department's priority date.
